trigger_condition: Logout on a profile whose fallback workspace codeMieUrl is also another profile's platform URL
guard_snippet: await sso.clearStoredCredentials(candidates[0]); // or clear only the URL holding credentials via getStoredPlatformCredentials
potential_consequence: Logout silently wipes credentials other profiles still rely on under the shared workspace host

trigger_condition: Refresh when stored credentials are expired; lookup deletes them and returns null
guard_snippet: const url = (await getStoredPlatformCredentials(config))?.url ?? getPlatformUrlCandidates(config).find(Boolean); // record which candidate expired
potential_consequence: Split-host user whose expired creds lived under codeMieUrl is re-logged-in against baseUrl instead

trigger_condition: Logout for non-CodeMie provider profile with only baseUrl set (no codeMieUrl)
potential_consequence: Clears the default global credential slot, logging out an unrelated SSO session

trigger_condition: getStoredCredentials throws (keychain/store error) on the first candidate URL
guard_snippet: try { credentials = await sso.getStoredCredentials(url); } catch (e) { logger.debug('lookup failed', e); continue; }
potential_consequence: Fallback workspace URL never tried; a transient P-lookup error blocks otherwise valid credentials

trigger_condition: CODEMIE_PROFILE_CONFIG lacks provider field or holds non-string baseUrl
potential_consequence: Profile baseUrl silently ignored; lookup uses only CODEMIE_URL and returns empty catalog

trigger_condition: Credentials missing under every candidate URL
guard_snippet: if (!found) logger.debug('[gemini-models] no SSO credentials for platform URL candidates');
potential_consequence: Validation silently skipped with no diagnostic, unlike sibling agents which raise a login hint
